newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ says too early for easing, risk upside.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ says too early for easing, risk upside.

text.p: The Reserve Bank on Friday said the medium term outlook for inflation appeared "quite encouraging", but it was still too early for an easing.
Governor Don Brash said the outlook for inflation and for the wider economy over the next 12 to 18 months was broadly in line with what the bank had envisaged in its June statement.
"We expect inflation will remain outside the top of our (0-2 percent) target range over the next few quarters, but should drop back quickly into the middle of the range in 1997 and beyond.
